snippet.title: How It Was Made: Harry Potter Audioscapes Behind The Scenes
snippet.description:
Relax into magic with Harry Potter Audioscapes, the new ambient listening experience designed to immerse you in the wizarding world.

Enjoy an expertly crafted combination of narration, sound design and bespoke music featuring a live ensemble, which combines to make a whole world out of audio.

The Gryffindor common room is Harry, Ron and Hermione’s home at Hogwarts, with its crackling fire and squashy chairs. This Audioscapes listening experience invites listeners to pull up a chair, sink in and feel like they’re settling into the wizarding world.

snippet.title: Harry Potter: From Film to Series ft. David Heyman
snippet.description:
Rhianna Dhillon sits down with producer David Heyman for an in-depth conversation about guiding Harry Potter from page to screen, building the creative teams behind the films and upcoming television series and stewarding the wizarding world through twenty-five years of magic.

David reflects on the directors and craftspeople who shaped the original films, the challenge of remaining faithful to the spirit of the books and how the expanded storytelling possibilities of television are allowing the creative team to explore Hogwarts and its characters in greater depth.

Then, entertainment journalist Law Sharma joins Rhianna to unpack everything we know so far about the first season of the Harry Potter series, Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone, before revealing a very special announcement.

Spanning a total of more than 21,000 square feet, with two levels of retail space, the Oxford Street flagship is inspired by Diagon Alley, bringing one of the wizarding world’s most iconic locations to life through immersive environments, enchanting discoveries and exclusive experiences around every corner. Visitors can explore beautifully themed spaces, discover one-of-a-kind products and uncover magical moments created especially for witches, wizards and Muggles alike.
